name: MI-12
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+21 district with a well-funded incumbent
Tlaib has $3.4M on hand vs. under $10K for the Republican
Markets price the race at 98% Democratic
No polls or expert ratings, but fundamentals are lopsided
model.rationale: Tlaib holds a heavily Democratic Detroit-area seat, has outraised her opponent by roughly 3,500-to-1, and prediction markets give her about a 98% chance of winning. With no competitive polling or spending against her, the fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit Democratic win.
model.watch: A major late-breaking scandal or outside spending surge against Tlaib would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rashida Tlaib is seeking another term in this Detroit-area district, which leans about 21 points Democratic at baseline and roughly 34 points on pure fundamentals. She enters the general election with $3.4 million on hand after raising $2.8 million, while Republican James Hooper has raised under $1,000 and holds about $8,000. No outside groups are spending against her.

There are no public polls or expert ratings for the race, but prediction markets price Tlaib at about 98%. With an incumbent this dominant in a seat this blue and an opponent with essentially no resources, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being turnout rather than the outcome.
